name: complexScore
doc:
复数打分（实数值，相位相关）：`Re⟪q,k⟫`。
这是把 ℂ 内积实化后可直接送入 softmax 的实值打分。
stmt: def complexScore (q k : ℂ) : ℝ
proof: RCLike.re ⟪q, k⟫

name: complexAbsScore
doc:
复数打分的模（相位不变）：`|⟪q,k⟫|`。
RoPE 只改变内积相位，故这是位置编码下稳定的打分口径。
stmt: def complexAbsScore (q k : ℂ) : ℝ
proof: Complex.abs ⟪q, k⟫

name: complex_softmax_pmf
doc:
任意实值打分的 softmax 是概率分布（非负 + 和为 1）：
softmax 的概率语义只依赖打分的**实数值**，与打分的来源（ℝ/ℂ）无关。
stmt:
theorem complex_softmax_pmf {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (score : ι → ℝ) :
    ProbDist (softmax score)
proof: ⟨softmax_nonneg score, softmax_sum_one score⟩

name: complex_score_softmax_pmf
doc: ℂ 打分（经 `complexScore` 实化）的 softmax 是概率分布。
stmt:
theorem complex_score_softmax_pmf {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]
    (q k : ι → ℂ) :
    ProbDist (softmax (fun i => complexScore (q i) (k i)))
proof: complex_softmax_pmf _

name: complex_abs_score_softmax_pmf
doc: ℂ 打分（经 `complexAbsScore` 取模实化）的 softmax 是概率分布。
stmt:
theorem complex_abs_score_softmax_pmf {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]
    (q k : ι → ℂ) :
    ProbDist (softmax (fun i => complexAbsScore (q i) (k i)))
proof: complex_softmax_pmf _

name: complex_attention_bound
doc:
**复数注意力输出界**：ℂ 打分的注意力输出是复 value 的凸组合，
被最大 value 范数界住：`‖Σᵢ softmax(score)ᵢ • Vᵢ‖ ≤ M`。
（`ℂ` 作为 ℝ-赋范空间调用 RealAttention `attention_output_bound`。）
stmt:
theorem complex_attention_bound {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]
    (q k : ι → ℂ) (V : ι → ℂ) (M : ℝ) (hV : ∀ i, ‖V i‖ ≤ M) :
    ‖convComb (softmax (fun i => complexScore (q i) (k i))) V‖ ≤ M
proof: attention_output_bound (fun i => complexScore (q i) (k i)) V M hV

name: complex_abs_attention_bound
doc: 复数注意力输出界（模打分口径）：同一凸组合界，打分用 `|⟪q,k⟫|`。
stmt:
theorem complex_abs_attention_bound {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]
    (q k : ι → ℂ) (V : ι → ℂ) (M : ℝ) (hV : ∀ i, ‖V i‖ ≤ M) :
    ‖convComb (softmax (fun i => complexAbsScore (q i) (k i))) V‖ ≤ M
proof: attention_output_bound (fun i => complexAbsScore (q i) (k i)) V M hV

name: complex_attention_bound_expanded
doc:
复数注意力输出界（`convComb` 展开形式）：把 `convComb` 展开成 `∑ i, w i • V i`
（`w` 为 `complexScore` 打分的 `softmax` 权重）后，输出仍被 `M` 界住。
此处陈述为「输出范数 ≤ M」，右端是 `M` 本身而非乘积形式；本定理与
`complex_attention_bound` 同源（证明即对其的一行转发），差别只在结论写成展开后的
显式和，供下游直接按展开形式消费。
stmt:
theorem complex_attention_bound_expanded {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]
    (q k : ι → ℂ) (V : ι → ℂ) (M : ℝ) (hV : ∀ i, ‖V i‖ ≤ M) :
    ‖∑ i, (softmax (fun j => complexScore (q j) (k j)) i) • V i‖ ≤ M
proof: complex_attention_bound q k V M hV

name: complex_rope_abs_score_family_invariant
doc:
**RoPE 下 |打分| 族不变**：query 在位置 m、第 i 个 key 在位置 `pos i`，
经复数 RoPE 旋转后 |打分| 向量与原 |打分| 向量逐项相等
（RealComplexRoPE `complex_rope_relative_abs`：相位因子 |e^{iθ(n−m)}| = 1）。
stmt:
theorem complex_rope_abs_score_family_invariant {ι : Type*}
    (θ m : ℝ) (pos : ι → ℝ) (q : ℂ) (k : ι → ℂ) :
    (fun i => complexAbsScore (complexRotate θ m q) (complexRotate θ (pos i) (k i)))
      = (fun i => complexAbsScore q (k i))
proof:
by
  funext i
  exact complex_rope_relative_abs θ m (pos i) q (k i)

name: complex_rope_attention_invariant
doc:
**复数 RoPE 注意力不变性（核心）**：位置编码不改变注意力的模决定性部分——
`softmax` 作用于 |打分| 得到的注意力权重在 RoPE 前后完全一致。
（相位 e^{iθ(n−m)} 模 1，只影响 `Re⟪·,·⟫` 的方向，不影响 `|⟪·,·⟫|`。）
stmt:
theorem complex_rope_attention_invariant {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]
    (θ m : ℝ) (pos : ι → ℝ) (q : ℂ) (k : ι → ℂ) :
    softmax (fun i => complexAbsScore (complexRotate θ m q) (complexRotate θ (pos i) (k i)))
      = softmax (fun i => complexAbsScore q (k i))
proof:
by
  rw [complex_rope_abs_score_family_invariant]

name: complex_rope_attention_output_invariant
doc:
RoPE 注意力的输出不变性（由权重不变 + value 不变推出凸组合不变）：
模打分口径下，RoPE 前/后的注意力输出相等。
stmt:
theorem complex_rope_attention_output_invariant {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]
    (θ m : ℝ) (pos : ι → ℝ) (q : ℂ) (k : ι → ℂ) (V : ι → ℂ) :
    convComb (softmax (fun i =>
        complexAbsScore (complexRotate θ m q) (complexRotate θ (pos i) (k i)))) V
      = convComb (softmax (fun i => complexAbsScore q (k i))) V
proof:
by
  rw [complex_rope_attention_invariant]

name: complex_rope_score_phase_relation
stmt:
theorem complex_rope_score_phase_relation (θ m n : ℝ) (q k : ℂ) :
    ⟪complexRotate θ m q, complexRotate θ n k⟫ =
      ⟪q, k⟫ * Complex.exp (((θ * (n - m) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
proof: complex_rope_phase_shift θ m n q k

name: complex_attention_eq_real
doc:
**实数据退化**：实数的 ℂ 内积实部 = 实数乘积，
故 ℂ 打分在实数据上等于 ℝ 打分 `x*y`（虚部为 0，无 ℂ 特有信息）。
stmt:
theorem complex_attention_eq_real (x y : ℝ) :
    complexScore (x : ℂ) (y : ℂ) = x * y
proof:
by
  unfold complexScore
  rw [RCLike.inner_apply]
  simp [Complex.conj_ofReal, Complex.ofReal_mul]

name: complex_attention_eq_real_family
doc: 实数据退化（函数形式）：逐项实数据的 ℂ 打分族 = ℝ 打分组。
stmt:
theorem complex_attention_eq_real_family {ι : Type*} (x y : ι → ℝ) :
    (fun i => complexScore ((x i : ℝ) : ℂ) ((y i : ℝ) : ℂ)) = fun i => x i * y i
proof:
by
  funext i
  exact complex_attention_eq_real (x i) (y i)

name: complex_attention_eq_real_weights
doc: 实数据退化（权重形式）：ℂ 打分与 ℝ 内积打分的 softmax 权重完全相同。
stmt:
theorem complex_attention_eq_real_weights {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]
    (x y : ι → ℝ) :
    softmax (fun i => complexScore ((x i : ℝ) : ℂ) ((y i : ℝ) : ℂ))
      = softmax (fun i => x i * y i)
proof:
by
  rw [complex_attention_eq_real_family]

name: complexRotate
stmt: def complexRotate (θ m : ℝ) (z : ℂ) : ℂ
proof: z * Complex.exp (((θ * m : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)

name: complex_inner_apply
stmt: theorem complex_inner_apply (x y : ℂ) : ⟪x, y⟫ = conj x * y
proof:
by
  simp

name: complex_conj_exp
stmt: lemma complex_conj_exp (z : ℂ) : conj (Complex.exp z) = Complex.exp (conj z)
proof:
by
  rw [Complex.exp_eq_exp_ℂ]
  exact NormedSpace.map_exp ℂ (starRingEnd ℂ) Complex.continuous_conj z

name: complex_conj_exp_mul_I
stmt:
lemma complex_conj_exp_mul_I (x : ℝ) :
    conj (Complex.exp (((x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) =
      Complex.exp (((-x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
proof:
by
  rw [complex_conj_exp]
  exact congrArg Complex.exp (by
    calc
      conj (((x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) = conj ((x : ℝ) : ℂ) * conj Complex.I := by
        rw [map_mul (starRingEnd ℂ)]
      _ = ((x : ℝ) : ℂ) * (-Complex.I) := by simp [Complex.conj_ofReal, Complex.conj_I]
      _ = ((-x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
        rw [Complex.ofReal_neg]
        ring)

name: complex_phase_abs_one
stmt:
theorem complex_phase_abs_one (θ m : ℝ) :
    Complex.abs (Complex.exp (((θ * m : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) = 1
proof: Complex.abs_exp_ofReal_mul_I (θ * m)

name: complex_phase_sum
stmt:
lemma complex_phase_sum (a b : ℝ) :
    (((a : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) + (((b : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) =
      (((a + b : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
proof:
by
  calc
    ((a : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I + ((b : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
        = (((a : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((b : ℝ) : ℂ)) * Complex.I := by ring
    _ = ((a + b : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by rw [← Complex.ofReal_add]

name: complex_rotation_preserves_abs
stmt:
theorem complex_rotation_preserves_abs (θ m : ℝ) (z : ℂ) :
    Complex.abs (complexRotate θ m z) = Complex.abs z
proof:
by
  unfold complexRotate
  rw [AbsoluteValue.map_mul]
  rw [complex_phase_abs_one θ m]
  ring

name: complex_rotation_compose
stmt:
theorem complex_rotation_compose (θ m n : ℝ) (z : ℂ) :
    complexRotate θ m (complexRotate θ n z) = complexRotate θ (m + n) z
proof:
by
  unfold complexRotate
  calc
    (z * Complex.exp (((θ * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) *
        Complex.exp (((θ * m : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
        = z * (Complex.exp (((θ * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
            Complex.exp (((θ * m : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) := by ring
    _ = z * Complex.exp (((θ * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I +
        ((θ * m : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by rw [← Complex.exp_add]
    _ = z * Complex.exp (((θ * (m + n) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
      exact congrArg (fun r : ℂ => z * Complex.exp r) (by
        calc
          ((θ * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I + ((θ * m : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
              = ((θ * n + θ * m : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := complex_phase_sum (θ * n) (θ * m)
          _ = ((θ * (m + n) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
            exact congrArg (fun r : ℝ => (r : ℂ) * Complex.I) (by ring))

name: complex_rope_phase_shift
stmt:
theorem complex_rope_phase_shift (θ m n : ℝ) (q k : ℂ) :
    ⟪complexRotate θ m q, complexRotate θ n k⟫ =
      ⟪q, k⟫ * Complex.exp (((θ * (n - m) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)
proof:
by
  unfold complexRotate
  rw [RCLike.inner_apply]
  rw [map_mul (starRingEnd ℂ)]
  rw [complex_conj_exp_mul_I (θ * m)]
  calc
    (conj q * Complex.exp (((-(θ * m) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) *
        (k * Complex.exp (((θ * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I))
        = conj q * k * (Complex.exp (((-(θ * m) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) *
            Complex.exp (((θ * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)) := by ring
    _ = conj q * k * Complex.exp (((-(θ * m) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I +
        ((θ * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by rw [← Complex.exp_add]
    _ = conj q * k * Complex.exp (((θ * (n - m) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
      exact congrArg (fun r : ℂ => conj q * k * Complex.exp r) (by
        calc
          ((-(θ * m) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I + ((θ * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I
              = ((-(θ * m) + θ * n : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := complex_phase_sum (-(θ * m)) (θ * n)
          _ = ((θ * (n - m) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
            exact congrArg (fun r : ℝ => (r : ℂ) * Complex.I) (by ring))

name: complex_rope_relative_abs
stmt:
theorem complex_rope_relative_abs (θ m n : ℝ) (q k : ℂ) :
    Complex.abs ⟪complexRotate θ m q, complexRotate θ n k⟫ = Complex.abs ⟪q, k⟫
proof:
by
  rw [complex_rope_phase_shift]
  rw [AbsoluteValue.map_mul]
  rw [complex_phase_abs_one θ (n - m)]
  ring

name: complex_rotation_preserves_norm
stmt:
theorem complex_rotation_preserves_norm (θ m : ℝ) (z : ℂ) :
    ‖complexRotate θ m z‖ = ‖z‖
proof:
by
  rw [Complex.norm_eq_abs]
  exact complex_rotation_preserves_abs θ m z

end Lattice
